claims.value: Bodart: side A (Bavarian) 6,500 men; side B (Prussian garrison) 1,450 men with 34 guns.
claims.rationale: Read on the registered page image. His general rule is forces disposable for the engagement, rounded upward (shared research-conventions index); a stated siege endpoint or engaged subset takes precedence over treating it as an opening count. Population/timing alternatives are not reconciled. English rendering (ours): "The Bavarians (6,500 men) under Lieutenant-General von Deroy force the Prussian garrison (1,450 men with 34 guns) under Major-General von Cornerut to capitulate after a nineteen-day blockade; after marching out with military honours the men became prisoners; officers could leave on parole."

claims.value: Side A (Bavarian): Höpfner allocates about 6000 infantry, 900 horses and 1000 artillerymen to Deroy’s blockade force; this is an assignment, not a verified simultaneous engaged total.
claims.rationale: Prussian retrospective account of the opposing allocation. Horses are not an additional human headcount; do not sum these categories into an admitted opening strength. English rendering (ours): "General Deroy was charged with the blockade of Brieg with his division, Mezzanelli’s cavalry brigade, three batteries and the necessary engineer troops, or about 6000 infantry, 900 horses, 1000 artillerymen,18 field guns and a park of two 12-pounders, two mortars and four heavy howitzers."

citations.quote: Mit der Blokade von Brieg wurde der General Deroy mit seiner Division, der Kavallerie-Brigade Mezzanelli, nebst 3 Batterien und den erforderlichen Genie-Truppen, oder mit etwa 6000 M. Infanterie, 900 Pferden, 1000 M. Artillerie, 18 Feldgeschützen und einem Park von 2—12Pfündern, 2 Mörsern und 4 schweren Haubitzen, beauftragt.

claims.value: Side A: Deroy commanded the blockade force; Napoleon asserted authority over Jérôme’s negotiations and required imperial permission for an armistice. Side B’s two commandants accepted the capitulation in Höpfner; only Cornerut is named in the inspected Bodart entry.
claims.rationale: Separates blockade command, superior control and the garrison’s decision. Does not infer the unnamed second commandant’s identity. English rendering (ours): "General Deroy was charged with Brieg’s blockade with his division and Mezzanelli’s cavalry brigade" English rendering (ours): "You have no right to meet an enemy general without my order; you have no right to make an armistice without knowing whether it harms my general plans." English rendering (ours): "the two commandants therefore decided to accept the offered capitulation"
